API_KEY_DOC: Generate your own key at developer.spotify.com > Dashboard > Spotify Soloist API Key. A Premium account is required to generate the key. Keep it secret.
RETAIN_API_KEY_DOC: Keep your API key and paired Spotify session on this device if the plugin is uninstalled, so reinstalling does not require re-entering the key or pairing again. Turn this off to erase everything on uninstall.
DEVICE_NAME_DOC: The name shown in the Spotify app's device list.
INITIAL_VOLUME_DOC: Connect-side volume when Soloist starts (0-100). Mirrored to the Volumio mixer. The stream stays full scale unless Output Trim is set.
CACHE_SIZE_DOC: Maximum playback cache size. Use 0 for unlimited; otherwise minimum 100. In RAM mode this is capped to what the board can spare and the value you save may be reduced.
CACHE_LOCATION_DOC: Where Soloist stores downloaded audio. Disk keeps it on the data partition and survives a reboot. RAM keeps it in memory, which removes all cache writes from a slow SD card, but costs that much RAM and is emptied at every reboot and every plugin restart. A lossless track is roughly 44 MB, so 100 MB holds about two. Only choose RAM if the board has memory to spare: on a 512 MB board such as a Pi Zero 2 W it is a significant share of the total.
BUFFER_MS_DOC: How much audio is buffered ahead of the DAC (100-2000). Volumio's ALSA chain applies this value twice, so lower values make skip, seek and pause respond faster. Too low risks dropouts on a busy device. Default 500.
SEEK_COALESCE_MS_DOC: Wait this long after the last slider move before sending one seek to Spotify (0-2000). A drag can fire dozens of seeks in a second; each one flushes audio. 0 sends every move. Default 200.
INACTIVE_HOLD_MS_DOC: Wait this long after Spotify reports the device inactive before pausing and releasing the output (0-10000). A seek can blink inactive and come back; yielding on that blink ends the Connect session. 0 yields immediately. Default 2000.
OUTPUT_TRIM_DB_DOC: Fixed gain applied to the Soloist stream before the ALSA chain (-12 to +12). Raises or lowers what Peppy and SoftMaster see from this source. The volume knob is unchanged. Default 0. About +6 if the meters sit at half height.
VERBOSE_DOC: Log every Soloist WebSocket event, and turn on the diagnostics in the audio shim: device lifecycle, per-second write counters, and what the shim does when ALSA reports a fault. Read with 'journalctl -u soloist -u volumio'. Changes no playback behaviour, but is noisy. Leave off unless investigating a problem.
UPDATE_DESC: Spotify Soloist builds expire 90 days after their build date. The plugin re-downloads automatically when the build expires, but you can also update manually here.
